[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (Members , UserY) , ...) , ... > .
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceA , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceA , ...) , UserY : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > .
[B2] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : K , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : K , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (deviceA ; K) .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (deviceA ; K)
=> < UserX | 'key' : K , ... > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'key' : K , 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA | (K)
=> < deviceA | 'key' : K , 'on' : true , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > < deviceA | 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'cloudTurnOn' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > < deviceA | 'on' : true , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > .

< cloudA | (userA : ('members' : nils , 'device' : deviceA) , userC : ('members' : nils , 'device' : nils)) > < deviceA | ('on' : false , 'key' : 'keyA') > < userA | ('key' : nils) > < userC | ('key' : nils) >

[B1] < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > => ev1(UserX, UserY) .
[B2] < UserX | ... > < deviceA | ... > => ev2(UserX) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : K , ... > < deviceA | ... > => ev3(UserX, K) .
[B4] < UserX | ... > < deviceA | ... > => ev4(UserX) .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY) , ...) , ... > => ev5(UserX, UserY) .

deviceOn =| < deviceA | 'on' : true , ... > .
attackerAuthorized =| < cloudA | userC : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > .
